notes.title: March 19 Update
notes.content:
[b][Bug Fixes][/b]

Fixed an issue where monsters would get stuck on doors or certain objects (assets) and be unable to move.

[b][Developer's Comment][/b]
Hello, I’m developer Kim Seoung Jin.
Watching everyone play, I realized once again that there is still much to improve.
Since this is a solo development project, unexpected bugs and inconveniences often arise.
Although progress may be slow, I will continue to fix bugs and improve the game.
Thank you so much for playing.
